Neither of you could do it on your own, but together…|Luthen Rael, to Saw Gerrera|{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}}} '''Spellhaus''' was an astronomical object that hosted a [[Spellhaus Imperial power station|power station]] for the [[Galactic Empire]]. By [[5 BBY]], the [[Anto Kreegyr's group|rebel cell]] led by [[Anto Kreegyr]] was probing the power station and planning an attack. As the rebel agent [[Luthen Rael]] unsuccessfully attempted to recruit forces of the [[Partisans]] rebel cell to join the mission, the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB) learned of Kreegyr's plans and began preparing to take him by surprise. Despite being informed of the ISB's knowledge, Rael allowed Kreegyr and his cell to fall into the trap and be [[Spellhaus attack|wiped out]] in order to preserve his [[Lonni Jung|mole]] in the ISB. ==Description== Spellhaus was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the [[Meerian sector]]'s [[Spellhaus system]] within an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[New Territories]]. Situated at the coordinates O-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it lay between the [[planet]]s{{HelmetCollectionCite|4|Databank A-Z}}[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']] [[Bandomeer]] and [[Botajef]] along the [[Hydian Way]] [[super-hyperroute]].{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}} ==History== ===Compromised plans=== {{Quote|Anto Kreegyr. I want you to meet him.''"
"''[Chuckles] Anto Kreegyr?''"
"''He's been probing the Imperial power station at Spellhaus. He's found a weakness in the defenses. It may take some time to work up, but he's got an angle.|Luthen Rael and Saw Gerrera|}} [[File:Luthen-Saw-Andor8.png|thumb|left|300px|Luthen Rael attempted to recruit Saw Gerrera for the Spellhaus attack]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Spellhaus hosted an [[Spellhaus Imperial power station|Imperial power station]] with at least one [[garrison]].{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} By [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|108}} the [[Anto Kreegyr's group|rebel cell]] led by the [[Neo-Separatist Coalition|Neo-Separatist]] [[Anto Kreegyr]] began probing the power station, with Kreegyr coming to believe he had found a way to successfully attack and destroy it. [[Luthen Rael]], a rebel agent that coordinated a shadowy [[Axis network|network]] linking Kreegyr's cell and other groups, learned of the plans and attempted to recruit the rebel [[Saw Gerrera]] and his cell, the [[Partisans]], to support Kreegyr's forces. Gerrera rejected the offer over his disagreements with Kreegyr's ideals. Meanwhile, the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB) learned of Kreegyr's plans to attack Spellhaus after a [[Unidentified rebel pilot (Anto Kreegyr)|rebel pilot]] from his cell was captured by the Empire and interrogated. The ISB planned to take Kreegyr's group by surprise and faked an accident to cover up the loss of the [[pilot]].{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} Rael soon learned of the matter from a mole{{Andor|One Way Out}} he had in the ISB, [[Lonni Jung]], but chose to let Kreegyr proceed as normal as to preserve Jung. ===Imperial hubris=== {{Quote|It is difficult now to look back on hundreds of incidents including those on worlds like Kashyyyk, Mimban, and Ryloth as well as the raids on Spellhaus and Aldhani and easily distinguish the coordinated from the spontaneous.|Beaumont Kin, ''The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire''|''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''}} [[File:Partagaz-debrief-Andor12.png|thumb|right|300px|The Imperial Security Bureau monitored the Spellhaus attack from afar.]] Gerrera soon agreed to join Kreegyr's attack and contacted Rael to make arrangements, wishing to loot the power station's eastern garrison. However, the agent stopped the Partisan leader, convincing his associate to instead play the long game with the ISB. Kreegyr led his group in an [[Spellhaus attack|attack]] on Spellhaus the next [[Standard day|day]], falling straight into the Empire's trap. All rebels there were killed as a result, with the [[ISB Board]] celebrating from their [[ISB Central Office|headquarters]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]], who was trying to track down Rael and his network, was displeased that no [[prisoner]]s were taken, but she was talked down by [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]], who claimed the victory was about satisfying [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] after the embarrassment of another [[Aldhani heist|rebel raid]] that [[Standard year|year]].{{AndorDate|106}} A file on the "Spellhaus Operation" covering Kreegyr's defeat was kept in the "Imperial Security Bureau" section of the [[Imperial Archives]]. Additionally, the [[Rebel Alliance Archives]] and Gerrera's [[datafile]]s covered the attack. The [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] researched these files, noticing discrepancies about the number of rebels that had died at Spellhaus. He subsequently wrote about Spellhaus in his [[35 ABY]]{{RiseAndFallDate}} [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'', where he discussed the uncertainty of the casualty number, as well as noting how the lack of prisoners was a missed opportunity for intelligence gathering. ==Behind the scenes== Spellhaus was first mentioned in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode in the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']]. The episode was released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{1stm}} *{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|One Way Out}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-10-episode-guide|text="One Way Out" Episode Guide | Andor}} *''[[The Ultimate Star Wars Quiz Book]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Spellhaus |fr=Spellhaus |ja=スペルハウス |ka=სპელჰაუსი }} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the New Territories]] [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Galactic Empire astronomical objects]] [[Category:Locations along the Hydian Way]] [[Category:Meerian sector locations]] [[Category:Terrestrial astronomical objects]]
